title: Express API with PostgreSQL
about: The REST API most Stacktape users start with: Express 5 with Prisma ORM over PostgreSQL, `GET /posts` and `POST /posts`, in one Lambda function behind an HTTP API, with the database next to it. Prisma brings a real dependency tree: a generated client and a native query engine that has to reach Lambda for the right Linux.

edit.to: res.send({ message: 'success', count: posts.length, data: posts });

changesFromStarter: The starter runs Express in a container (`web-service`). Here the same Express app runs in a Lambda function through `serverless-http`, the adapter most Express-on-Lambda projects use, instead of `app.listen`.
The Prisma schema asks for the `rhel-openssl-3.0.x` query engine (Lambda's Amazon Linux 2023) instead of the Alpine one the container needs.
Every direct dependency is pinned to an exact version, the newest within the starter's own range.
